Summary

I embed inside a business, learn how the work actually gets done, and build the AI-native systems that change it, owning architecture and technical direction end to end and staying accountable for outcomes in production. Two decades across tech, data, and commercial operations in health, finance, sports, and consumer. Most recently I built ARCS from scratch: an AI-native decision-intelligence platform on Claude with an MCP server and agentic orchestration, running in production. Before that I served as the sole product-and-technology partner on a seven-figure embedded engagement inside a $350M-ARR behavioral health company, discovery through QA and handoff, and led go-to-market for 10 SEC/FINRA-regulated products at Grayscale ($7B launched). I work end to end: frame the problem, choose the architecture, build the system, and keep iterating as capabilities shift. I use AI in my own work every day and have strong opinions about where deterministic software and human judgment need to stay in control.
